package probe

import (
	"os/exec"
	"unsafe"
)

// unsafe reaches a command's fields by offset, out of the check's sight: the
// Env field written here is one the check never proves. In a file that imports
// os/exec, an import of unsafe is a finding at the import line, a sibling of
// the generic-function rule (P6). No test/e2e file imports unsafe today.

func unsafeEnv(cmd *exec.Cmd) {
	cmd.Env = []string{}
	field := unsafe.Pointer(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(cmd)) + unsafe.Offsetof(cmd.Env))
	*(*[]string)(field) = nil
}
